mappings.interpretation: Legacy Verticals remain immutable compatibility IDs. Their business meaning is Core Domains v1 for Provider mapping; actual market Verticals are dynamic outcomes.
Flat file remains compatibility input only.
Entity identities are separated into source record, physical object, canonical design, market event and evidence assertion.
Provider is a Market Sensor and cannot determine Portal categories or Index membership.
Portal becomes a Projection consumer only.
Existing files remain Experience compatibility data until a Track B-assessed Index output exists.
